compatibility.semantics: Same snapshots, source campaigns, splits and public starts. Previously used validation is development data. No new heldout claim.

initialization: Random weights, paired seeds. One full-sized random network per seed; all common tensors copied and embedding rows mapped by name into each fresh variant. No trained teacher weights used. Fresh native PPO optimizer/RNG/cursor/counters after warm-up.
interpretation:
Complete vocabulary shows a modest greedy-play signal: two additional wins out of 42 in each matched seed, giving 59.5% mean greedy success versus 54.8% for the observed-vocabulary control. This is not corroborated by sampled play (48.8% versus 49.4%) or consistently better paired HP. On shared losses, vocabulary-only leaves Vantom +2.63 / -1.88 HP relative to the controls; on shared wins, player HP changes -1.65 / +0.46. The overall evidence remains preliminary.

Adding descriptions does not help in this pilot: 53.6% mean greedy and 48.2% sampled success. It loses two / three greedy wins per seed against the equal-capacity vocabulary-only models. Training-opening scores are 64/68 for control, 65/65 for vocabulary-only and 61/66 for descriptions.

Keep the selected 250k teacher as the reference (61.9% greedy, 54.8% sampled), while retaining vocabulary-only as the most promising fresh representation candidate. The teacher has a different, larger training history and was previously selected on these validation cases. Two fresh weight seeds sharing one demonstration pool on reused development validation do not establish a general improvement; TEST remains unopened.

The next controlled experiment should address value-head fitting during warm-up: its error on unused TRAIN campaigns worsens across all three representations despite lower fit error. Compare the existing schedule with shorter or separately fitted critic calibration while holding actor training fixed. This is a diagnostic hypothesis, not a demonstrated cause of the PPO performance changes.
limitations: Two fresh weight seeds share one teacher-data sample, with supervised warm-up before PPO; not random-start PPO.
Teacher was historically validation-selected and uses a larger prior training budget. It is an unmatched reference, not the representation control.
Repeated development-validation use; no new test confirmation or population-wide claim.
Complete vocabulary changes token coverage and parameter count; metadata versus vocabulary-only holds capacity fixed.
Static descriptions are partial mechanical features, not an exact simulator or textual reasoning model.
The observed-vocabulary control fits names on this TRAIN warm-up partition, not the historical 564-token checkpoint.
This 50k pilot does not test longer budgets, other bosses or full-run performance.

protocol.primary: Fixed50k validation greedy wins per paired seed versus fresh observed-vocabulary control. Full descriptions versus vocabulary-only isolates metadata at equal model size.
protocol.secondary: Sampled wins, paired common-loss bossHP, common-win completed playerHP, unconditional bossHP, TRAIN win rate, warm-up fit/monitor KL and speed.
protocol.selection: 0 means after warm-up before PPO;0/25k diagnostic only. No early stopping, no automatic promotion; TEST closed.
protocol.uncertainty: Two fresh seeds, one shared teacher-data sample, repeatedly used42-case development validation. Teacher selected historically on these cases and has larger prior budget. This is fresh learners with supervised warm-up, not random-start PPO or independent confirmation.

question: Do complete public vocabulary and static potion/relic descriptions help when fresh graph learners use them from their first update?

results.hp_definition: Winning HP uses canonical completed CombatSummary after post-combat hooks, matching the reward. Raw evaluation player_hp is before those hooks and is not used for the headline metric. Boss HP comes from the retained stable enemy slot.
results.interpretation: Exploratory two-seed fresh catalog-representation pilot. All networks begin with matched random weights and receive the same TRAIN-only teacher warm-up. Vocabulary is fitted only on the TRAIN fit partition; catalog arms add static public knowledge. Evaluation at0 means after warm-up, before PPO. Final 50k is primary; 0/25k are diagnostics. The parent was previously selected on this reused validation and every arm uses its TRAIN action targets, but none copies its weights. No independent test confirmation. Conditional HP means can change when win/loss populations change; common-outcome deltas are paired.

teacher.role: Teacher and unmatched historical reference only; no weights copied

teacher_data.vocabulary_fit: TRAIN fit partition only; monitor never fitted

timings.preparation_scope: First recorded task clock to frozen protocol, including inspection, experiment implementation, preflight and overlapping independent review; review time not measured separately.

review_addendum.limitations: Two fresh seeds, one shared teacher-data sample, repeatedly used42-case development validation. Teacher selected historically on these cases and has larger prior budget. This is fresh learners with supervised warm-up, not random-start PPO or independent confirmation.
review_addendum.post_protocol_changes: No training, evaluation or initialization changes after protocol freeze. Additional analysis/plots summarize fixed results and warm-up curves; no retraining or checkpoint selection.
review_addendum.review: Author final results and artifact review; independent protocol review remains bound by plan.

warmup.monitor: Not fitted and not used for selection or early stopping. All TRAIN cases available to subsequent PPO.
warmup.objective: KL(teacher || student) + .25 * completed-episode Monte Carlo value MSE; cutoff steps have policy targets but no value target.
warmup.optimizer: Adam lr.001,foreach false,gradient clip1; 2000 updates,batch32,same minibatch-index stream within seed.
warmup.source: One shared8192-decision TRAIN-only teacher sample. Deterministic source-campaign80/20 fit/monitor split; vocabulary fit on fit partition only.

warmup_diagnostics.interpretation: Post-hoc diagnostic. Fit value MSE falls while source-campaign monitor MSE rises after early warm-up. This is compatible with critic overfitting, not a causal explanation of PPO validation changes. Fixed protocol unchanged.
